_comment: Club-item resource ids that draw the green NOT FOUND placeholder.
The four family ranges in tools/build_clubitems.py were established by
finding where each family STOPS -- the probe visited 24 kit ids and every
one of them was above 6300860 -- and the interior was then assumed
contiguous. It is not. These are the holes found since, one card at a time.
Add an id here the moment a NOT FOUND card comes out of a pack. Both the
builder and the running server read this file, so a new id takes effect on
the next server start without rebuilding the catalogue.
